gloss: around the clock; day and night; all the time

definitions.gloss: around the clock, all the time, day and night
definitions.explanation: Constantly, without interruption. Emphasizes that something continues throughout the entire day. Derived from 4 × 6 = 24 (hours).

examples.japanese: {四六時中|しろくじちゅう}⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ている→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: You're looking at your phone all the time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{四六時中|しろくじちゅう}⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えている→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: He thinks about work around the clock.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれて→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、{四六時中|しろくじちゅう}{目|め}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{離|はな}せない→離す：19372_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: Since the baby was born, I can't take my eyes off them day or night.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
From {四|し} × ⟦{六|ろく}→六：00747_roku⟧ = 24, referring to the 24 hours in a day. An older form {二六時中|にろくじちゅう} (2 × 6 = 12) referred to the old Japanese system of 12 time divisions per day.

USAGE:
Often carries a slightly exaggerated or critical tone, implying someone is doing something too much or obsessively.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {四六時中|しろくじちゅう}～⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧: to be doing ~ all the time
- {四六時中|しろくじちゅう}⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧: to think about constantly
- {四六時中|しろくじちゅう}⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧: together all the time
